metadata.title: Do indeksa
metadata.description: A free platform for choosing a degree program and preparing for the entrance exam.

prep.title: Preparation plan
prep.description: A personal FTN P1 preparation plan with one concrete next action.
prep.intro: One clear step based on your answers, mistakes and the current exam structure.
prep.settingsDescription: These details help choose a realistic practice volume, but they are not an admission forecast.
prep.goalDisclaimer: The current P1 maximum is {max} points. A target is a planning reference and does not guarantee admission or funding.
prep.allDoneDescription: You can stop here or choose extra practice without changing today's completed plan.
prep.actionPractice: Solve {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} from position {position}
prep.actionReview: Retry {count, plural, one {# recent mistake} other {# recent mistakes}}
prep.actionCheck: Short check: {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}
prep.reasonNoData: Start with one task from each position to establish a useful baseline.
prep.reasonMissingBaseline: You have individual answers, but no check across the full P1 structure yet.
prep.reasonErrors: Your recent answers in position {position} include {count, plural, one {# mistake} other {# mistakes}}.
prep.reasonHints: You used help {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} in position {position}.
prep.reasonUntested: There are no answers for position {position} yet. Start with a short set.
prep.reasonLowEvidence: Position {position} has only {count, plural, one {# answer} other {# answers}} so far. More evidence is needed.
prep.reasonStale: Position {position} has not been checked for more than a week.
prep.reasonMaintain: A short check maintains confidence without taking your whole evening.
prep.reasonRecentErrors: Return to recent mistakes and confirm that you can now solve them independently.
prep.reasonPreferences: A goal and date help the plan choose a realistic pace.
prep.readinessMethod: Average across {total} positions. It uses the latest five answers; fewer than three lowers confidence, and assisted answers receive less weight.
prep.readinessDisclaimer: This is an internal practice metric, not an official score or admission prediction.
prep.guestDescription: Without signing in, your answer history stays in this browser only.
prep.positionProgressIntro: Each position uses recent answers from the corresponding topics in the current P1 structure.

diagnostic.title: Check your starting level
diagnostic.description: A focused P1 diagnostic: 10 tasks, one per exam position, in about 25 minutes.
diagnostic.intro: A short check across the complete entrance-exam structure. Answer what you know and skip anything you have not covered yet.
diagnostic.factCoverage: One task for every position in the current P1 structure.
diagnostic.factSkip: You can skip a task without it counting as a wrong answer.
diagnostic.factSaved: The active run stays on this device; completed answers sync after you sign in.
diagnostic.progressSaved: {completed} of {total} positions completed. Your run is saved.
diagnostic.mockActive: A mock exam is already in progress. Finish or abandon it before starting the diagnostic.
diagnostic.otherDiagnosticActive: A different diagnostic run is already in progress.
diagnostic.abandonConfirm: Leave this diagnostic? This run will be removed and will not affect your knowledge map.
diagnostic.invalidAnswer: Complete every answer field using a readable notation.
diagnostic.checkUnavailable: The answer could not be checked. Try again without leaving this page.
diagnostic.resultIntro: This is a practical starting point, not an official exam score. Skipped positions remain untested and are kept separate from measured gaps.
diagnostic.confidentDescription: Positions where your answer was accepted.
diagnostic.startHereEmpty: No measured gap in this run.
diagnostic.untestedDescription: Skipped positions with no result yet.
diagnostic.firstStepDescription: Begin with measured gaps, then cover skipped positions. The set opens directly on the first task.
diagnostic.missingResultBody: The run may belong to another browser or may not be finished yet. Return to the diagnostic to continue or start again.

home.tagline: A free platform for choosing a degree program and preparing for the entrance exam.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: A topic-based task bank with solutions for the FTN P1 entrance exam.
tasks.intro: Ten mathematics topics from the P1 entrance exam. Their order may differ between annual exam versions.
tasks.topicDescription: Tasks with solutions from {topic} for the FTN P1 entrance exam.
tasks.checkerUnavailable: Answer checking is currently unavailable. Please try again.
tasks.hintLockedNote: Need help? A hint unlocks after your first attempt.
tasks.incorrectBody: Check your calculation and notation, then try again.
tasks.invalidFormat: I could not read this notation. Check the answer format.
tasks.unsavedExit: The entered answer has not been checked. Exit this task?

taskBank.searchPlaceholder: Search by statement, topic or task code
taskBank.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {# task selected} other {# tasks selected}}
taskBank.emptyQuery: Nothing matched “{query}”. Try a shorter query or change the filters.
taskBank.emptyFilters: These filters do not match any current tasks. Change or reset them.

calculator.title: FTN score calculator
calculator.description: Calculate your FTN admission score and compare it with recent thresholds for every degree program.
calculator.heading: FTN score calculator
calculator.formula: Total = secondary school performance (sum of all four yearly averages × 2, up to 40) + entrance exam (up to 60).
calculator.minimums: Legal minimum: 50.01 for a state-funded place · 30.01 for self-funded study.
calculator.legend: Yearly grade averages and entrance-exam points
calculator.disclaimer: Thresholds represent the last admitted student in official <link>FTN enrolment statistics</link>. They change every year. After the 2024 entrance-exam reform, use only 2024 and 2025 as a guide.

simulation.title: Mock exam
simulation.description: A mock entrance exam in the P1 format: 10 tasks, 4 hours and up to 60 points.
simulation.intro1: P1 format: 10 tasks, 4 hours and up to 6 points per task, for a maximum of 60.
simulation.intro2: Work on paper. After submitting, compare your method and final answer with the solution. Binary self-assessment gives only an indicative trainer estimate.
simulation.abandonConfirm: Abandon this attempt? It will not be added to your history.
simulation.diagnosticActive: You already have a diagnostic in progress.
simulation.gradingIntro: Compare your method and final answer with the solutions, then mark whether the final answer is correct. FTN grades the method and may award partial credit; this check cannot measure that.
simulation.estimateDisclaimer: This is not an official FTN result. The final score depends on the shown method and partially correct steps.
